target_customer: Retail investors who want stock picks and guidance on when to buy, how much and when to sell
problem: Everyday people lack the research and discipline to pick stocks, so the app curates a monthly list of ten stocks and prompts the user to approve trades.
business_model: Consumer subscription (a user review cites about $20 per month; unverified)
product_category: Consumer investing app, stock picks and research

technical_complexity.rationale: A curated stock list plus brokerage-linked approval flows relies on third-party institutions, so the engineering is standard consumer fintech.

defensibility.rationale: Stock picks and a consumer UI are easy to copy and the company itself says it is only a technology provider using third-party financial institutions.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found describing an incumbent response. The app was still on the App Store with about 1.2K ratings per a 2026 listing.

market_need_then: No dated source found. The YC pitch is retail investors wanting guidance on what to buy.

branding.domain_note: Uses meetbenson.com, a prefix on the name; no date or price found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source I opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Short conversational headlines such as 'Investing minus the work' (company site, accessed 2026)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, no mascot, and the common personal name Benson is easily confused with other businesses in search results.

outcome_analysis: Benson is listed as active with a three person team and a consumer app still receiving updates according to an App Store listing, but no source gives verified funding, traction or founders. The record cannot support a success or failure story, so the factors stay empty. A single search for shutdown, acquisition or layoffs found nothing about this company.
notes: Founders: the YC page lists none and the company site names none. Reviews on the site mention a CEO called Phillip, which is unverified so not recorded. Funding unverified: Bounce Watch lists about $620K including a $500K pre-seed in 2022-03, CB Insights lists $1.09M for a similarly named profile; these aggregators conflict and are not recorded as rounds. Competitors: aggregator pages (toolmage, undated) list Public, Magnifi and others but none are dated near the 2022 batch, so the list is empty. The app developer on the App Store is Yunit Inc. CB Insights lists $1.09M over five rounds with a July 2022 accelerator round and investors MasterCard Start Path, Western Union Accelerator, Techstars and Cathexis Ventures, which conflicts.
